integrity: The main theorem has an analytic integral and edge-counting proof; numerical checks are supporting evidence only. Self-review does not confer independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Motion-invariant affine plane sampling only, not Haar central sections or unweighted intersecting normals. Definitive historical priority uncertain because full text of Voss 1982 was inaccessible; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact three-atom Crofton section law for right rectangular pyramids
